summary: The Bootstrap Results tab's Full Ladder can now step by 5%, 1%, 0.5%, 0.1% or 0.01%, as ResQ's Percentiles choice does.
details: Pick the interval from the dropdown beside Full Ladder; Copy Table and Download CSV follow it.
0.1% and 0.01% re-run the simulation from its seed, so the ladder takes a moment and matches the run on screen exactly.
